Jio Rolling Out Targeted 'Buy 1 Get 1' Promotion for Selected Prepaid Users on the Rs 349 Plan

Reliance Jio has begun rolling out a targeted promotional offer for selected prepaid subscribers, offering an additional Rs 349 recharge free of charge upon purchasing the standard Rs 349 plan. The promotion, widely referred to as a Buy One Get One (BOGO) or 1+1 deal, is being communicated directly to eligible users via official SMS channels and verified RCS for Business chats through the JioReach account.

According to user reports and promotional messaging, the initiative applies exclusively to specific mobile numbers chosen by the operator. Recipients have reported receiving alerts indicating that after completing a standard Rs 349 recharge, an additional recharge of equal value is provided. The standard Rs 349 prepaid plan typically includes a 28-day validity window, 2GB of high-speed daily data, unlimited voice calls, 100 daily SMS messages, and access to unlimited 5G data where available.

Checking Eligibility and Locating the Offer

Because the promotion is user-specific rather than universally available across all accounts, subscribers cannot automatically claim the benefit without verification. Users who believe they may be eligible can check their status through several official channels:

  • SMS Inbox: Look for official promotional messages confirming that the Buy 1 Get 1 offer is active on the specific mobile number.
  • RCS Chat: Check the messages application for communication from the verified JioReach business account containing promotional banners.
  • MyJio Application: Log into the official MyJio app and review home screen banners, the dedicated offers section, or navigate to 'My Vouchers' by searching for vouchers within the application interface.

Promotional banners observed by users indicate that the extra recharge may appear as a promotional voucher priced nominally (such as Rs 0.01) with distinct redemption options and validity dates.

Practical Implications and Safety Precautions

For eligible subscribers, the promotion effectively lowers the per-month cost of maintaining connectivity by pairing two billing cycles together. However, because the mechanics and final distribution of the bonus recharge can vary depending on account attributes, consumers should exercise caution and verify plan details prior to initiating any payments.

Industry analysts and consumer safety guidelines emphasize several important considerations regarding telecom promotions:

  • Targeted Availability: The offer is strictly limited to numbers that receive direct communication from Jio. Universal access is not guaranteed.
  • Lack of Fixed Expiry: Official messaging denotes the promotion as a "limited period offer" without specifying a strict concluding date.
  • Security Risks: Scammers frequently impersonate telecom operators during promotional rollouts. Users must ensure links originate strictly from official domains (such as jio.com) or the MyJio application. Subscribers should never share One-Time Passwords (OTPs), UPI PINs, or banking credentials with third parties claiming to facilitate the free recharge.

Readers wishing to verify the authenticity of any promotional notification should bypass external links entirely and check their active plans, recharge history, and voucher sections directly inside the official MyJio application.
